No labels, gridlines, background, floor, shadows or detached effects. Do not tilt the entire sheet. Preserve identity: original plain white plump one-piece ghost with short side arms and two stubby feet; no animal ears, no accessories, preserve original white mascot identity. Omit the detached yellow sparkle decorations
